title: "Student Roster"
params:
  course: conbio
  canvas_id: 96266
---

```{r}
#| context: setup

here::i_am("conbio/roster.qmd")

source(here::here("_common.R"))
```

```{r}
roster <- get_course_students(my_canvas, params$canvas_id) %>%
  filter(name != "Test Student") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(sortable_name, ", ", names = c("last", "first_official")) %>%
  mutate(first = case_match(
    last,
    "Bradley" ~ "E.",
    "Dillon"  ~ "Sam",
    .default = first_official
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    name = as.character(str_glue("{first} {last}"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    last,
    name,
    login_id,
    sis_user_id,
    id,
    first_official
  ) %>%
  arrange(last)

save(roster, file = here(params$course, "roster.RData"))
```
